data.title: 牧濑红莉栖 · 实验室屏幕前的学术交锋
data.description: 未来道具研究所深夜，示波器与多联显视屏泛着冰蓝冷光。红莉栖单手插在大白褂兜里，另一手握着Dr.Pepper罐头，神采飞扬地向冈伦阐述时间跳跃理论。
data.location: cluttered Akihabara lab room with glowing CRT monitors, oscilloscopes, and tangled cables
data.action: standing beside lab bench, one hand holding chilled soda can while gesturing with other, fierce brilliant argument gaze
data.lighting: 多联屏幕荧光与暖钨丝台灯
data.promptProse: Kurisu stands in the dimly lit Akihabara lab holding a can of Dr. Pepper, animatedly arguing theory in the cold glow of multiple CRT monitors.
data.animaCaption: Blue monitor glow reflects across her lab coat and chestnut hair as she gestures with the soda can. The desk lamp reveals her face, oscilloscopes and cables beside the glowing monitors.
